scope.allowed_inputs: Archived RQ1 aggregate CSV/JSON, small numeric bootstrap NPZ loaded allow_pickle=False, source code and metadata only
scope.not_checked: No per-flight rederivation, no original month/date boundary enumeration, no figure visual QA or causal identification

raw_ge15_summary.sample_rule: accepted, upstream delay >=15 min, non-overnight; ground >=0 allowed
raw_ge15_summary.interpretation: Descriptive raw differences; airport composition is unadjusted and results are not causal.

network.difference_interpretation: Different UTC scheduled-departure window/population; no new raw decomposition performed, so do not attribute all 3101 excluded rows to one cause.

summary.scope: 2026-08 local FlightDate; explicit post-freeze final mode

single_flight_summary.distribution_population: normal completed flights only; cancellations and diversions summarized separately

summary.aircraft_unknown_policy: unknown tail/model retained as an explicit category
summary.airport_activity_note: Flight movements and eligible connection counts are separate columns; connections use D0003 QA cohort month.
summary.rq2_weather_coverage: Not requested; no feature archive was read.

local_august_EDA.population_boundary: Single-flight outcomes: local BTS FlightDate August. Airport connection counters: D0003 qa_cohort_month (upstream actual arrival UTC month). RQ1 full/monthly: UTC upstream actual-arrival prediction windows. These denominators are not interchangeable.

denominator_definitions.n: All accepted, valid, nonovernight upstream-delay-threshold connections at this airport across all eligible cells, within the UTC period.
denominator_definitions.retained_n: Connections in this airport and threshold-specific frozen common cells; includes unsupported selected airports in monthly totals unless explicitly subset to supported.
denominator_definitions.standardized_mean: Common fixed development reference weights applied to saved cell mean downstream-minus-upstream nonnegative delay; not raw sum(delta)/retained_n.

boundary_zero_scope.actual_computation_source: scripts/final_evaluation.py::_boundary_counts uses only the frozen D0003 accepted connection file
boundary_zero_scope.does_not_establish: Does not establish zero cross-UTC-boundary records among all raw local-August flights, all candidate chains, or excluded/invalid/cancelled/diverted/absent connections. This review did not count raw boundary rows.
boundary_zero_scope.interpretation: D0003 qualification is indexed only by April-August upstream actual-arrival UTC months; the zero is conditional on this constructed accepted cohort and may be structurally enforced. It is not an independent boundary audit of all raw local-August flights.

interpretation_limits: Descriptive conditional connection differences, not causal airport effects or general operational performance rankings.
Full-period ge15 FLL is the only positive point estimate; its interval crosses zero, so do not claim demonstrated amplification there.
All supported full-period estimates have 1000 finite replicates; percentile intervals are not multiplicity/selection adjusted.
Monthly unsupported standardized estimates, intervals and shares remain NA; do not replace with zero or renormalize weights.
Sensitivity thresholds alter eligible populations and condition one master reference; correlation is not proof of invariance.
s_plus/s_minus/s_net are sample cumulative minutes, not common-weight standardized minutes per connection.
Bootstrap NPZ contains saved numerical aggregates; finite-count/quantile recomputation here does not rerun the original resampling from raw rows.
